notes.title: Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon – Steam Achievements Unlocked!
notes.content:
SYNCHRONIZING… UPDATE RECEIVED. 
 
[b]Steam Achievements[/b] now available in [b]Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon[/b]! Sgt. Rex "Power" Colt isn’t done yet! it's time to unleash neon-drenched chaos, and collect every single achievements like the badass cyber-commando you are.
 
[h1]GOOD TO KNOW[/h1]

[h3]Do Achievements Sync Automatically?[/h3]
If you’ve previously unlocked achievements in Ubisoft Connect, simply launch the game once on Steam, and your progress will sync automatically.

Are you ready to be a legend?
